description: This file defines a Java interface for the LoanAccrualTransactionBusinessEventService, which declares a method to raise business events related to accrual transactions on loans.

classes.name: LoanAccrualTransactionBusinessEventService
classes.description: A Java interface that specifies a contract for raising business events related to loan accrual transactions.

methods.name: raiseBusinessEventForAccrualTransactions
methods.description: Method to trigger a business event for accrual transactions associated with a given loan and a list of existing transaction IDs.
